news.body:
## A decision with a date on it now
- The Founder Sprint applications close on 1 December, and your info session is the 18th.
AI Venture Lab confirmed your seat this morning. It is 45 minutes, and the application window shuts thirteen days after it. - Go in with the two questions that actually decide it: when the sprint runs, and how many hours a week it wants.
## Tonight runs past midnight
- Hilti at 01:00 and Monitor Deloitte at 01:30, your time.
Both LatAm fair slots are listed in CET, so they land after midnight in India. Tomorrow's CDC CV webinar is a civilised 17:30. - Pick one of the two tonight rather than sitting through both.
